title: highball - Ocean World: Eden Crafters Prologue
notes: Game never reached the main menu or rendered a playable window. Steam briefly showed the game as running before it exited. Tested on Apple M4 using Wine 10.0 Sikarugir r28 and Wine 11.0 CrossOver 26.3 r29, with the same OpenGL context creation failure. No FPS measurement possible because the game never displayed a frame. Find The Needle Demo runs successfully on the same Mac using Highball. issues: The game fails to launch. Steam briefly shows it as running, but no game window appears. Logs report GLFW_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE and failure to create an OpenGL context.
